execution_order: Independent H1/H2/packet-loss campaigns ran concurrently. Baselines predate final candidates; H2 rounds 2 and 3 run before then after. Baselines are reused unchanged across candidate evaluations. Extended H2 before/after ran concurrently in separate namespaces. No host interface was changed.
sampling_caveat: A fixed PRNG seed does not fix goroutine scheduling, TCP timing or random-number call order. Repeats are observations, not confidence intervals.
final_candidate: quarter chunk on probe-confirmed no progress, 4 KiB floor, reset backoff on probe-confirmed progress; SSH/config handshake timeout
baseline: previous low-footprint optimization; reverse optimization.patch in an isolated copy to reconstruct production source
binary_match: Final production sources rebuilt to an identical after Node SHA256 after rejecting the 1 KiB candidate.
